sources.title: Naga City Ordinance No. 2003-003, Section 6
sources.note: Enacted January 15, 2003. Lists the house beside the Villa Francia building on Peñafrancia Avenue, unnamed.

sources.title: Google Street View
sources.note: August 2025 panorama inspected October 8, 2026. A white clapboard two-storey house with capiz window bays and ventanilla rails, now the Zynergia Naga City Business Center, stands immediately northeast of Villafrancia. It is the only old house adjoining it: the southwest neighbour is a modern single-storey shop strip and the rear is garden and riverbank. Capture dates are not construction dates. No image is saved or distributed.

sources.title: Google Maps satellite
sources.note: Public satellite reference inspected October 8, 2026 with the frozen OSM outlines. The roof at the avenue edge northeast of Villafrancia occupies way/23669321. Imagery date is unknown; no age is inferred and no bitmap ships.
